summary: Full-extraction pass over 20 US documents (eCFR whistleblower rules for SEC, CFTC and IRS; FinCEN budget, NPRM, press release and web pages; the Zafirov order; GAO-11-683, GAO-16-20, GAO-18-279 and GAO-18-698; HHS-OIG state FCA page; House Report 119-370; Illinois AG release; IRS annual reports FY2008-FY2009). Adds 585 observations (mostly GAO claim-status and closure tables, IRS monthly receipts, FinCEN tip lifecycle, wildlife rewards), 92 rules, 20 events and 26 cases (25 wildlife reward cases, Zafirov). 16 documents complete, 4 partial (image figures/tables needing a visual read, and two decisions on scope).

events.description: Amendments published at 82 FR 24487-24501: among others new sections on award eligibility (165.5), related actions (165.11), appeals (165.13), program administration (165.15), non-waiver (165.19), anti-retaliation (165.20) and Appendix A on retaliation.

events.title: House passes earlier kleptocracy rewards bill (H.R. 389)
events.description: The House passed H.R. 389, an earlier version of the Kleptocracy Asset Recovery Rewards Act, by voice vote; the Senate took no action in the 116th Congress (the measure was later enacted through the FY2021 NDAA).
events.quote: On May 14, 2019, the House suspended the rules and passed the bill by voice vote.

events.title: House committee approves H.R. 5344 by 50-0
events.description: The Financial Services Committee ordered H.R. 5344 (making the programme permanent for seven years after enactment) reported favourably by a recorded vote of 50 yeas, 0 nays.
events.quote: by a recorded vote of 50 yeas and 0 nays

events.title: Whistleblower Executive Board first meets
events.description: The Whistleblower Executive Board (chaired by the Whistleblower Office Director, with Chief Counsel and operating division executives) held its first meeting; the IRS also awarded a contract for a new case management system that month.
events.quote: In July 2008, the Whistleblower Executive Board held its first meeting.

events.title: IRM whistleblower award procedures revised
events.description: The IRS published revised Internal Revenue Manual provisions on section 7623 after a comprehensive review; the Director of the Whistleblower Office now makes all award determinations, including 7623(a).
events.quote: published revisions on December 30, 2008

events.title: New whistleblower case management system in use
events.description: The IRS began recording all new section 7623 claims in a new commercial off-the-shelf case management system; by the end of FY2009 all 7623(b) claims had been converted to it.
events.location: printed p. 4 (PDF p. 5), III.B Case Management Information System
events.quote: In January 2009, the IRS began using a new case management system based on commercial-off-the-shelf technology to record all new section 7623 claims.

events.title: IRM 25.2.2 revised again (award process guidance)
events.description: Revised IRM 25.2.2 issued in June 2010 with procedures on the award process as an administrative proceeding, disclosure to whistleblowers, award criteria and application of 7623(b) procedures to 7623(a) cases.
events.quote: Revised IRM 25.2.2 incorporating these changes was issued in June 2010.

events.title: FinCEN starts receiving whistleblower tips
events.description: Since May 2021 whistleblowers have been sending tips, mainly by email, to FinCEN's Office of the Whistleblower, which reviews and shares them with FinCEN Enforcement, OFAC and DOJ.

events.title: Proposed regulations widen "collected proceeds"
events.description: IRS proposed regulations (76 Fed. Reg. 2852) defining collected proceeds to include denied refunds and reduced overpayment credits when computing awards.

events.quote: Exec. Order No. 13773, 82 Fed. Reg. 10,691 (Feb. 14, 2017).

events.quote: On March 26, 2018, IRS withdrew its appeal before the U.S. Court of Appeals.

events.title: IRS announces the new definition of proceeds on its website
